name: Helmets of Stars
source:
In the distant galaxy known as the Celestial Expanse, the wise High Council governs a realm of countless star systems, where noble houses vie for power, influence, and resources. As a member of the Helmets of the Stars, an elite order of space knights, you are entrusted with maintaining peace and stability amidst a complex web of political intrigue.

[From [url=https://varzyche.itch.io/helmets-of-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在被称为“天穹”的遥远星系中，睿智的高级议会统治着无数星系的领域，贵族家族在这里争夺权力、影响力和资源。作为星际头盔（太空骑士精英组织）的一员，你肩负着在复杂的政治阴谋网络中维护和平与稳定的重任。

[来自[url=https://varzyche.itch.io/helmets-of-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
